title: Jazzy Algerian Chicken Tagine
description: A classic French-inspired North African dish, made with tender chicken and a rich, flavorful sauce. Perfect for a cold winter night. The jazzy spice blend adds a modern twist to this traditional recipe.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the algerian spice blend and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the ground almonds, diced tomatoes, chicken broth, and honey (if using).
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the tagine and cook for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs (if desired).
